SELECT t1.*, ROUND(100 - SUM(NVL(fcp.prin_amt, 0)), 6) intPrinAmt FROM ( SELECT t8.CASH_ID cashId, t8.CASH_TYPE CASH_TYPE, SUM(T8.QTY)*100 qty, t8.SEC_ACCT_ID secManageAcctId, nvl(SAI.SEC_ACCT_NAME, fp.FINPROD_NAME) secAcctName, FPD.COLLECT_TYPE collectType, CASE WHEN SAI.SEC_ACCT_ID IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END channel, t10.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, t10.FINPROD_NAME finprodMarketName, TO_CHAR(t8.VDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') vDate, TO_CHAR(t8.MDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') mDate, T10.FINPROD_ID, T10.CCY, T10.ISSUER issuer, ROUND(t8.INT_AMT, 12) unitIntAmt,/*单位应计利息*/ TO_CHAR(T10.VDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') vDateWhole,/*起息日*/ TO_CHAR(T10.MDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') mDateWhole,/*到期日*/ ROUND(t8.PRIN_AMT, 4) prinAmt,/*还本面额/百元*/ T8.RANGE_YIELD*100 yield,/*区间票面利率（%）*/ TO_CHAR(T8.PAY_DATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') payDate,/*支付日*/ TO_CHAR(T8.PAY_DATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') tradeDate,/*交易日*/ ROUND(sum(T8.intAmt), 8) intAmtTheory,/*理论应计利息*/ ROUND(sum(T8.prinAmt), 4) prinAmtTheory,/*理论还本金额*/ T10.TRADE_MARKET, ROUND(sum(t8.fpriceAmt), 4) fpriceAmt,/*理论本息总额*/ NULL PA_BUSS_TYPE from (select T1.FINPROD_ID, T1.AMOUNT QTY, listagg(T1.CASH_TYPE, ',') within group ( order by T1.CASH_ID ) CASH_TYPE, listagg(T1.CASH_ID, ',') within group ( order by T1.CASH_ID ) CASH_ID, min(T1.VDATE) VDATE, T1.MDATE, SUM(T1.CASH_AMT * T1.AMOUNT) fpriceAmt, /*理论本息总额*/ sum(case when T1.CASH_TYPE IN (#{CASH_CLASS_TYPE01}, '04') then 0 else T1.PRIN_AMT * T1.AMOUNT end) prinAmt, max(T1.INT_PRIN_AMT) INT_PRIN_AMT, T1.SEC_ACCT_ID, SUM(T1.PRIN_AMT) PRIN_AMT, SUM(T1.INT_AMT) INT_AMT, SUM(T1.int_amt * T1.AMOUNT) intAmt, /*理论利息*/ T1.PAY_DATE, max(t1.RANGE_YIELD) RANGE_YIELD from (SELECT T1.FINPROD_ID, T1.PORTFOLIO_ID, DECODE(T1.HODING_TYPE, '06', T1.AMOUNT*-1,'11', T1.AMOUNT*-1, T1.AMOUNT) AMOUNT, T1.SEC_ACCT_ID, t2.vdate, t2.mdate, t2.cash_amt, t2.prin_amt, t2.INT_PRIN_AMT, t2.int_amt, t2.cash_id, t2.cash_type, t2.pay_date, t2.RANGE_YIELD FROM PTL_SEC_POSITION_RULE T1 INNER JOIN FIN_CASH_PLAN T2 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T2.FINPROD_ID AND T2.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{FINPROD_TYPE_TGF01} AND t1.CDATE < t2.MDATE LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO pp on pp.PORTFOLIO_ID = T1.PORTFOLIO_ID WHERE T1.AMOUNT > 0
AND T1.HODING_TYPE = 'A_004' and nvl(pp.PARENT_PORTFOLIO_ID,'null') = 'null' AND T1.SEC_ACCT_ID = #{secAcctId} AND T2.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} AND T2.MDATE = to_date(#{mDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') and T2.CASH_TYPE IN (#{CASH_CLASS_TYPE01},#{CASH_CLASS_TYPE02},#{CASH_CLASS_TYPE03},#{CASH_CLASS_TYPE04}) and (t2.INT_AMT > 0 or t2.PRIN_AMT > 0) /*不存在生效的交易*/ and NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL TPDA LEFT JOIN TRD_DEAL_TOTAL_ADD TDTA ON TPDA.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = TDTA.TOTLE_TRADE_ID where TDTA.MP_FINPROD_ID IS NULL and TPDA.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS01} AND TPDA.BUSI_TYPE = #{TRD10} AND TPDA.IS_CANCEL = #{YESNO_N} and T2.MDATE = TPDA.MDATE AND TPDA.FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID AND T1.PORTFOLIO_ID =TPDA.PORTFOLIO_ID AND (TPDA.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID = T1.SEC_ACCT_ID OR TPDA.CHL_ID = T1.SEC_ACCT_ID)) /*不存在流程中的当期或之前的交易*/ AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM WFL_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL TPDA LEFT JOIN WFL_TRD_DEAL_TOTAL_ADD TDTA ON TPDA.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = TDTA.TOTLE_TRADE_ID where TDTA.MP_FINPROD_ID IS NULL and TPDA.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS01} AND TPDA.BUSI_TYPE = #{TRD10} AND TPDA.IS_CANCEL = #{YESNO_N} and T2.MDATE >= TPDA.MDATE AND TPDA.FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID AND T1.PORTFOLIO_ID =TPDA.PORTFOLIO_ID AND (TPDA.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID = T1.SEC_ACCT_ID OR TPDA.CHL_ID = T1.SEC_ACCT_ID))
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM PTL_SEC_POSITION_RULE tpsp where tpsp.HODING_TYPE = T1.HODING_TYPE and tpsp.PORTFOLIO_ID = T1.PORTFOLIO_ID and tpsp.SEC_ACCT_ID = T1.SEC_ACCT_ID and tpsp.FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID and tpsp.CDATE > T1.CDATE and tpsp.CDATE < t2.MDATE )
) T1 group by T1.FINPROD_ID, T1.MDATE,T1.AMOUNT, T1.PORTFOLIO_ID, T1.SEC_ACCT_ID, T1.PAY_DATE) T8 LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T10 ON T10.FINPROD_ID = T8.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO SAI ON T8.SEC_ACCT_ID = SAI.SEC_ACCT_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT FP ON T8.SEC_ACCT_ID = FP.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD FPD ON FP.FINPROD_ID=FPD.FINPROD_ID WHERE T10.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{FINPROD_TYPE_TGF01} and T10.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = #{finprodMarketId} GROUP BY t8.CASH_ID , t8.CASH_TYPE, t8.SEC_ACCT_ID,SAI.SEC_ACCT_NAME, fp.FINPROD_NAME,SAI.SEC_ACCT_ID, t8.PRIN_AMT, t8.INT_AMT/*还本金额*/, t10.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, t10.FINPROD_NAME , t8.VDATE, t8.MDATE, T10.FINPROD_ID, T10.CCY, T10.ISSUER, T10.VDATE, T10.MDATE, T8.RANGE_YIELD , T8.PAY_DATE , T10.TRADE_MARKET, FPD.COLLECT_TYPE ) T1 LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_PLAN fcp ON fcp.FINPROD_TYPE2 =#{FINPROD_TYPE_TGF01} AND fcp.MDATE < to_date(T1.MDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AND T1.FINPROD_ID = fcp.FINPROD_ID and fcp.CASH_TYPE IN (#{CASH_CLASS_TYPE02}) and fcp.PRIN_AMT > 0 GROUP BY t1. cashId, t1.CASH_TYPE, t1.QTY, t1.secManageAcctId, t1.channel, t1.secAcctName, t1.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, t1.finprodMarketName, t1.vDate, t1.mDate, t1.FINPROD_ID, t1.CCY, t1.issuer, t1.unitIntAmt , t1.vDateWhole , t1.mDateWhole , t1.prinAmt , t1.yield , t1.payDate , t1.tradeDate , t1.intAmtTheory , t1.prinAmtTheory , t1.TRADE_MARKET, t1.fpriceAmt , t1.PA_BUSS_TYPE, t1.collectType
